whatItIs: QuantumKatas is an open-source project in the games and learning category. It is maintained by Microsoft and primarily looks like a Jupyter codebase. >**We are modernizing the quantum katas experience.

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches games and learning workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes: >**We are modernizing the quantum katas experience. Please visit https://quantum.microsoft.com/experience/quantum-katas to try the new online Azure Quantum katas experience, with integrated assistance from Copilot in Azure Quantum.** For the Modern QDK repository, please visit Microsoft/qsharp.
whoItsFor: Beginners, educators, and curious developers who want a more approachable path into quantum concepts.
whatYouCanBuild: Get a gentler introduction before diving into full SDKs.
